cruise.label: 和爸妈坐一次邮轮
cruise.wish: Take a cruise trip with my mom and dad — the three of us at the ship railing, ocean wind in our faces.

definingProps: hair and clothes blowing in one direction
spec.people: three figures leaning on the railing, looking out together
spec.mustNotDrawAs: a generic cruise ship floating on water without the specific focus on the three people at the railing

cello.label: 学会大提琴
cello.wish: Learn to play the cello well enough to perform one piece for my friends in my living room.

definingProps: bow held in a playing position
spec.people: one person sitting and playing the cello, with two friends sitting on a sofa watching
background: a framed picture on a wall
motion: a few musical notes floating in the air
soft light rays from the lamp
spec.mustNotDrawAs: a professional concert hall with a large stage, formal audience, or tuxedo attire

van.label: 房车环游全国
van.wish: Convert a campervan and drive it around the whole country, waking up somewhere new.

definingProps: a map spread across the dashboard
a half-open sliding door revealing a rumpled bed
a mountain bike strapped to the back
spec.people: one figure sitting on the edge of the open door, holding a steaming mug
background: a winding road disappearing into the distance
motion: a light breeze blowing through the open van curtains
spec.mustNotDrawAs: a generic van parked in a generic parking lot with no sense of travel or the 'waking up somewhere new' feeling
